name: Conditional 3D Gaussian Splatting Generation
definition: Generates 3D Gaussian Splatting representations conditioned on text prompts, input images, or partial 3DGS inputs containing large occlusions.
summary: Conditional 3D Gaussian Splatting Generation directly synthesizes 3D Gaussian fields from text, images, or partial inputs using feedforward or diffusion models, bypassing iterative optimization.
